Tee Barb defaults are length=+1.5pt 2, width=+3pt 4, inset'=+0pt .5, and line width=+0pt 1 1. Setup clamps length-inset and negative inset to half the arrow stroke, derives tip/backend/line-end extents, and constructs either a single stem, a one-sided bar, or a complete I-shaped outline. Harpoon retains one side; left and right choose the retained side; reversed reflects tip geometry and changes shaft shortening; round and sharp select cap/join behavior; slant shears the finished tip. This fixture exercises default and fixed dimensions at both path ends.

The core resolves deferred length, width, inset, and stroke dimensions against the active path width, applies start-tip reversal and explicit reversed/swap transforms, shortens each shaft by the declared line end, and rotates polar-bending tips onto curved terminal tangents.
